properties.name: orion.client.fetch-registry
properties.description: Determines whether the Orion client should fetch the registry information automatically on startup.

properties.name: orion.client.heartbeat-rate-sec
properties.description: The interval in seconds at which the client sends heartbeat messages to the Orion server. Could not be less than lease-duration-sec.

properties.name: orion.client.kafka.bootstrap-servers
properties.description: The address of the Kafka broker(s) that the Orion client connects to for message publishing and consumption.

properties.name: orion.client.kafka.trusted-packages
properties.description: A comma-separated list of package names that the Kafka client considers as trusted for deserialization.

properties.name: orion.client.lease-duration-sec
properties.description: The duration in seconds for which a lease is valid before service would be removed from registry. Must be at bigger than 'orion.client.heartbeat-rate-sec'.

properties.name: orion.client.self-registration
properties.description: Determines whether the Orion client should automatically register itself with the Orion server at startup.

properties.name: orion.client.kafka.group-id
properties.description: Each client must have a different group id to obtain the full registry.
